project.name: RigSpark
project.one_liner: RigSpark updates signed local-LLM advice catalogs without replacing the application.
project.audience: Local-LLM users who want current recommendations while normal advice stays offline

claims.text: Catalogs update independently of application releases

evidence.quote: RigSpark can activate a signed model catalog independently of an application release.

claims.text: Recommendations and normal startup remain offline

evidence.quote: Updating is always explicit; recommendations and normal startup remain offline.

claims.text: Invalid updates leave the current snapshot unchanged

evidence.quote: Invalid signatures, incompatible catalogs, and network failures leave the current snapshot unchanged.

claims.text: Updates verify a signature before atomic activation

evidence.quote: Updates verify an Ed25519 signature and model schema before atomic activation.
